The authors are, in alphabetical order: Emma Bailey, Yanni Bills, Feng Cheng, Osanda Chinthila, Aryan Dugar, Ali Eser, Eric Han, Chirag Kar, Matthew Junge, Viet Le, Jiaqi Liu, Zoe McDonald, Si Tang, Michael Thomas, Scott Wynn, and Eric Yu.

projects.name: Numerical Linear Algebra Algorithm Development
projects.summary: Implemented and benchmarked core numerical linear algebra algorithms (eigenvalue solvers, factorizations) in C and Python to rigorously evaluate algorithmic complexity and machine precision limits.

projects.name: Finite Difference Solver Development
projects.summary: Engineered multi-dimensional finite difference simulators in Python and C to model highly non-linear physical systems, mainly focusing on conservative, entropy-preserving methods for shockwave problems.

projects.name: Physics Informed Neural Networks for Inverse PDEs
projects.summary: Implemented Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) in PyTorch to solve nonlinear PDEs. Analyzed accuracy and convergence of learned solutions, identifying sensitivity to architecture and optimization dynamics.

projects.name: Applied Math Project; Celestial Mechanics
projects.summary: An expository work on Lagrangian mechanics from the point of view of the calculus of variations as applied to celestial mechanics, specifically the 2-body problem.
